# Lighthouse

> Lighthouse makes two products. Lighthouse Memory is persistent, verifiable long-term memory for AI agents, shared across sessions, machines and every MCP-capable agent, including Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Cursor. Lighthouse Storage is encrypted decentralized storage: one API and SDK that route files across IPFS, Filecoin and Walrus, with client-side threshold encryption and on-chain access control.

Lighthouse Memory gives agents remember, recall and forget tools through a hosted MCP server or a TypeScript SDK, and stores every memory as a content-addressed blob (CID) on Lighthouse Storage, Walrus, or your own S3-compatible bucket. Lighthouse Storage is used directly by apps for files, NFT media, datasets and backups, with Kavach encryption and token-gated access. Over 34,000 developers use Lighthouse.

Every page on this site is also available as markdown: append `.md` to any path, or send `Accept: text/markdown`. Prefer those over the HTML. `llms-full.txt` holds the long-form corpus: how Memory and Storage work, how each compares with alternatives, pricing and an extended FAQ.

## Lighthouse Memory (AI agent memory)

- [What is Lighthouse Memory](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/memory/intro): durable, portable long-term memory for AI agents; remember / recall / forget; engines, storage and embedders
- [Quick start](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/memory/quick-start): store and recall a first memory in minutes, offline first, then durable on Filecoin or Walrus
- [Connect agents over MCP](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/memory/mcp/overview): hosted MCP server at `https://memory-api.lighthouse.storage/mcp` for Claude Code, Claude Desktop and any MCP client
- [MCP tools](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/memory/mcp/tools-common): memory_remember, memory_recall, memory_list, memory_get, memory_forget, memory_status and more
- [Memory dashboard](https://memory.lighthouse.storage): add memories, connect agents, manage storage, encryption, API keys and plans
- [Encrypt your memories](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/memory/tutorials/dashboard-encryption): per-account key split across 5 key servers, decrypted only inside a Phala enclave; search keeps working
- [Use your own bucket](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/memory/tutorials/dashboard-own-bucket): keep memories and the search index in Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Supabase or MinIO
- [Encrypted Walrus engine (Memwal)](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/memory/tutorials/memwal-encrypted-memory): SEAL-encrypted memory with relayer-side search
- [Choose a network](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/memory/how-to/choose-network): local folder, S3, IPFS + Filecoin or Walrus
- [Rebuild and recovery](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/memory/how-to/rebuild-index): restore a full memory store on a new machine from one snapshot CID
- [SDK overview](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/memory/sdk/overview): the `@lighthouse-ai/*` packages (core, engine-batched, engine-memwal, storages, embedders, cloud-sync)
- [Use cases](https://www.lighthouse.storage/use-cases): memory for trading agents, prediction markets, tokenised assets and physical AI

## Lighthouse Storage (encrypted decentralized storage)

- [Lighthouse Storage overview](https://www.lighthouse.storage/storage): encrypted storage across IPFS, Filecoin and Walrus
- [Storage documentation home](https://docs.lighthouse.storage): entry point for all storage products and SDKs
- [Storage quick start](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/quick-start): first upload in a few minutes
- [Create an API key](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/how-to/create-an-api-key): one key for Memory and storage
- [IPFS + Filecoin](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/intro): hot retrieval on IPFS with Filecoin deals underneath for durability
- [IPFS + Walrus](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/ipfs-walrus/intro): erasure-coded blob storage on Sui, addressed as CIDs
- [Encryption features](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/how-to/encryption-features/): share, revoke and condition access to encrypted files
- [MCP protocol reference (storage tools)](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/how-to/ai/mcp-protocol): storage as native agent tools
- [x402 pay-per-use upload](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/tutorials/x402-pay-per-use-file-upload): an agent pays for storage in stablecoins on Base inline with an HTTP request
- [Glossary](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/concepts/glossary): CID, deal, epoch, threshold encryption and related terms

## S3-compatible API (L3)

- [L3 introduction](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/s3/intro): point AWS CLI, boto3 or rclone at Lighthouse storage
- [Create S3 keys](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/s3/how-to/create-s3-keys): exchange a Lighthouse API key for S3 credentials
- [S3 and IPFS semantics](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/s3/reference/s3-and-ipfs): how mutable S3 operations map onto immutable content addressing
- [Supported operations](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/s3/reference/supported-operations): buckets, multipart uploads, presigned URLs, pagination

## SDKs and common operations

- [Upload data](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/how-to/upload-data/): JavaScript, Node, Python, Go and CLI
- [Upload encrypted data](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/how-to/upload-encrypted-data/): client-side encryption before upload
- [Python SDK](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/tutorials/use-python-sdk): installation and usage
- [Go SDK](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/tutorials/use-go-sdk): installation and usage
- [Check Filecoin deals](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/how-to/check-for-filecoin-deals): deal status for a stored CID
- [IPNS for mutable data](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/how-to/ipns-handle-mutable-data): a stable name over changing content
- [Migrations](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/how-to/migrations/): move in from other storage providers
- [Migrate IPFS to Walrus](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/ipfs-walrus/how-to/migrate-ipfs-to-walrus): CIDs are preserved across the move

## Access control

- [Token gating and custom contracts](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/tutorials/token-gating-and-custom-contract): gate decryption on contract return values
- [Token gating NFTs](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/tutorials/token-gating-nfts): ERC-721 and ERC-1155 ownership conditions
- [Secure file sharing](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/tutorials/secure-file-sharing): per-recipient conditional access
- [Pay-to-view media](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/tutorials/create-pay-to-view-media): a payment contract gates decryption
- [zkTLS](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/zktls): zkTLS proofs as an access condition
- [Account delegation](https://docs.lighthouse.storage/account-delegation): authorize another account to act on your behalf
